name: Reopi
description: Reopi was a Core Worlds desert world. It featured the vast equatorial area known as the Red Reopi Deserts. There, magus creatures fed on insects and reptiles and was in turn preyed upon by the Reopi sand crushers. Under strict government regulation, private Reopi businesses hunted magus for their hides, which were prized off-world.
